data.title: Measure the Shapes
data.description: Drag each shape onto the ruler, align the left edge to zero, and type its width in inches.

challenges.label: Green Rectangle
challenges.hint: Look where the right edge of the shape lines up on the ruler.

challenges.label: Amber Rectangle
challenges.hint: Line the left edge up with 0, then read where the right edge lands.

challenges.label: Sky Square
challenges.hint: The small marks between the numbers are halves. Count carefully.

challenges.label: Blue Rectangle
challenges.hint: Measure from 0, not from 1. Where does the shape end?
